articles.title: JD Vance confronts Jewish GOP skeptics ahead of a potential 2028 run - CNN
articles.description: Vice President JD Vance has in recent months given voice to a rising skepticism in America toward Israel, leaving some Jewish Republicans uncomfortable, if not openly concerned, about the expected GOP frontrunner in the next presidential election.
